QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) forwards that empty vector. It also returns empty when `tokenizer_` is null.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns an empty vector both for a failed tokenization (forwarded from the tokenizer) and when `tokenizer_` is null. It also says the empty result "is not distinguishable from a legitimate empty input", which covers the point that the two cases look the same.
